item.description: This 2015 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe is finished in White over a Yachting Blue leather interior with plaid accents, and it is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.8L flat-six that drives all four wheels through a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch transaxle and an electronic limited-slip rear differential. item.title: 2000 AM General M1045A2 HMMWV
item.description: This 2000 AM General HMMWV M1045A2 four-door slant-back is powered by a 6.5-liter diesel V8 linked to a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and front and rear limited-slip differentials. item.title: 2014 Ferrari California
item.description: This 2014 Ferrari California is finished in Grigio Silverstone over Nero leather and was optioned with carbon-fiber interior trim, 20" diamond-finished Sport wheels, a carbon-fiber steering wheel, Scuderia Ferrari fender shields, Daytona-style seats, and yellow brake calipers. item.title: 1971 Chevrolet K5 Blazer CST 4×4
item.description: This Medium Olive 1971 Chevrolet K5 Blazer is a CST 4×4 that is said to have been registered with one owner in South Dakota until 2016, when it was acquired by RustyK5 of Des Moines, Iowa. Their subsequent body-off refurbishment included body and interior refreshes in addition to overhauls for its frame, wiring, 350ci V8, and drivetrain, which has a three-speed automatic transmission. item.description: This 2020 Ferrari GTC4Lusso V12 has 16k miles through the current owner's purchase in 2025, and it is powered by a 6.3-liter V12 that drives all four wheels through a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and a 4RM EVO four-wheel-drive system. item.title: 748-Mile 2023 Maserati MC20 Coupe 23 Speciale Package
item.description: This 2023 Maserati MC20 coupe has 748 miles and is one of 23 examples optioned with the 23 Speciale Package, which added a black roof, an electronic limited-slip differential, heated power-adjustable seats, a power-adjustable steering column, and a Sonus Faber sound system. item.title: 18k-Mile 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster
item.description: This 1989 Porsche 911 Speedster is one of 823 US-market examples produced for the model year, and it shows 18k miles following the current owner's purchase in 2020. Powered by a 3.2-liter flat-six paired with a G50 five-speed manual transaxle, the car was specified in Linen Metallic over a Linen partial leather interior, which features power-adjustable sport seats. item.title: 7k-Mile 2003 Acura NSX-T 6-Speed
item.description: This 2003 Acura NSX-T was purchased by the current owner in 2007 and shows under 7k miles following registration history in New Jersey and Ohio. The car is powered by a 3.2-liter DOHC V6 that received a replacement timing belt in 2025, and shifting is through a six-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 174-Mile 2022 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4
item.description: This 2022 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 is one of a planned 112 examples designated for production and was purchased new from Lamborghini Austin in Texas in February 2023. Finished in Ad Personam Oro Eleos over Nero Ade leather, the car is powered by a naturally aspirated 6.5-liter V12 that drives all four wheels with assistance from a 48-volt electric motor and supercapacitor integrated into a seven-speed automated manual transmission. item.title: 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera Speedster by Gunther Werks
item.description: This 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera is one of 25 examples modified by Gunther Werks to their Speedster specification in a build that was completed in 2024.
